d: A former slave (Ossie Davis) starting a new life with his family must decide whether to confront white opposition or flee.
An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer; the plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.
After foiling a girl's attempt to rob the general store, Lucas finds that she and her brother are plotting the murder of their abusive stepfather.
A young man who is determined to avoid becoming a henpecked husband must weigh his love for an overbearing woman.
Brackett insists an injured boy is a child-abuse victim; the paramedics aid a trapped boy and a fallen hiker; guest Richard Jaeckel.
Mysterious happenings in the 4077th seem to confirm the Korean belief in an unseen world of demons and ancestral spirits.
Hawkeye's extreme exhaustion manifests itself in the form of nocturnal basketball games and frightening nightmares.
Radar is accepted to the "Famous Las Vegas Writers School" and begins recording his impressions of the 4077th.
Stumped by a crossword puzzle, Hawkeye radios a Navy buddy for help, but his call is interpreted as a medical emergency.
Thelma Lou uses Gomer and flirts with him to make Barney jealous after he says that he has her in his hip pocket. Things escalate when she slips and kisses Gomer on the cheek.

Andy, Barney, and Gomer take Opie and a couple of his friends on a camping trip. When Opie leaves early in the morning to pick berries, Barney and Gomer go looking for him but end up getting lost in the woods.
Ray goes on a Caribbean cruise with Marie after Frank hurts his knee.
Doug Heffernan comes over to hang out with Ray while Debra and the kids are away for the weekend.
Sophia accidentally comes away with the visiting pope's ring, then refuses to return it.
Sophia seeks a swinging senior through the personals column; Rose can't recall an old beau who comes to visit her.
Guests Tim Conway, Valerie Harper.

st: The Case of the Carefree Coronary
d: A small insurance company retains Mason to look into a mysterious outbreak of apparent heart attacks.
A lovesick man finds unexpected results when he buys a potion from a stranger to help woo the woman he desires.
A bank teller (Robert H. Harris) invents a seemingly foolproof plan to come up with a lot of quick cash. With Jerry Paris and Philip Pine.
While traveling in chauffeured car, a woman (Jessica Tandy) with psychic powers hears a voice telling a tragic love story.
The search for a missing hit-and-run victim puts Mannix in the midst of a war between crime families.
Cannon tries to help a close friend accused of murdering his wife.
Barnaby seeks a witness (Gary Lockwood) who could clear his client of a bank employee's death.
Homer Bedloe returns to Hooterville with a new scheme to sabotage the Cannonball.
After several failed job attempts, Bobbie Jo writes a newspaper article about Dr. Craig, which upsets half of the subscribers in Hooterville.
When the Clampetts take up jogging, Mr. Drysdale joins in to seek new business for his bank.
The Drysdales sell their mansion to singer Pat Boone, who is intrigued by Granny's cooking.
Popeye, Bluto, Olive Oyl and all his seafaring friends star in these original theatrical cartoons from the genius of Max Fleischer; included are Betty Boop and Bimbo shorts.
Adventures of the animated cat and mouse.

A collection of timeless cartoon shorts that span from 1934 to 1972, featuring the mischievous Woody Woodpecker and his colorful cast of friends including Chilly Willy, The Beary Family, Inspector Willoughby, Andy Panda, and more.
The greatest animated characters and cartoons produced at Warner Bros. legendary Termite Terrace; Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Road Runner and all their friends are featured here weekly.
Gordon and West switch a prisoner in Vladivostok, without leaving the United States; guest John Astin.
An old friend of Adams and McCullough joins the wagon train and shares the fact that he has recently discovered a gold mine in the nearby hills.
A family defends their ranch in 1870 California.
Miss Kitty attempts to keep a young boy from his father, who is a fugitive and a killer.
An Army sergeant (Ben Johnson) faces court-martial if Candy can't find evidence to prove him innocent of desertion, cowardice and murder.
Lucas and Mark find themselves held at gunpoint by a prisoner being transported on a train, which becomes stranded from a plague of grasshoppers.
Mark discovers that the new preacher and his wife are impostors planning a robbery.
The drovers find a lost boy, armed with Roman candles, who lies to them about being orphaned in an Indian massacre.
Paladin must carry a message of forgiveness from the bedside of an ailing general. With Richard Boone and David White.
The pony express hires Josh to find the murderer of a rider who stole a diamond ring.
The trio shelters a redhead from an emperor.
Cujo, a friendly St. Bernard, contracts rabies and conducts a reign of terror on an American farm.
An old man goes raccoon hunting with his beloved dog, a hunt from which neither return.
A beautiful Romulan commander (Joanne Linville) woos Spock after capturing the Enterprise in the neutral zone.

st: They Have Been, They Are, They Will Be ..
d: Kolchak suspects extraterrestrial involvement when a series of electronic-equipment thefts is linked to several bizarre murders.
A space showman snatches most of the Robinsons for his interplanetary zoo.

t: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
d: The Seaview loses its power system while investigating a spacecraft that fell into the ocean.
The travelers battle two ruthless Earthmen (Warren Stevens, Jerry Douglas) from the year 5477.
Vincent prevents the assassination of an astrophysicist, who plans to reveal proof of the aliens' presence.

st: The Frog Is a Deadly Weapon
d: A private investigator informs Britt that he has proof that presumed-dead racketeer Glen Connors is still alive. Soon after, Nat is found floating dead in the harbor from a possible boating accident. The Green Hornet sets out to prove otherwise.
An illegal bootleg liquor ring devised by Dirk forces a stranglehold on bars in the town to buy from them. Reporter Mike Axford is kidnapped as he tries to follow a lead to the racketeers.

t: The Life and Times of Grizzly Adams
d: Grizzly comes upon a fugitive man searching desperately for a bag he lost.
The habits and adaptations of the animals that live at the North and South Poles.
Comparisons and contrasts are drawn as Marlin and Jim analyze the behavior of the lion in its natural habitat in Africa and in the zoo.
The Ngorongoro, a giant crater in Africa that helps keep herds safe from humans.
An examination of the destruction of animals natural habitats.
The animals of the Okefenokee swamp.
In the forbidding land north of the Arctic Circle, people can hunt seal with Eskimos, find polar bear and beluga whale.
Greg involves the whole family in a moviemaking project for school.
Greg seems sick, but Alice discovers a love note he wrote to a mysterious "Linda.".
Plans for a holiday feast at the Clampett mansion go awry when Elly makes a pet of the Thanksgiving turkey.
The Clampetts travel to Hooterville to spend Thanksgiving with their friends.

Gomer enlists and joins the Marines to test himself as a man, with Andy driving him to the base for his first day at boot camp. When Andy learns that the sergeant plans to get Gomer home, he tries to prevent Gomer from getting kicked out.

Ricky brings home a mink coat he'll use in his show and Lucy thinks it's for her. When Lucy finds out that Ricky arranged for the coat to be stolen from their apartment, she gets even by cutting up a fake fur in front of him.
Uninvited Beaver wants to wreck Wally's party.
Wally grows a mustache to make his girlfriend thinks he's mature.

When Charlie Brown (Peter Robbins) enters the school spelling bee, the perpetually crabby Lucy (Pamelyn Ferdin) predicts his humiliation. But with the help of his best friend, Linus (Glenn Gilger), and faithful dog, Snoopy (Bill Melendez), Charlie Brown not only wins the spelling bee, he's chosen to attend the national spelling bee in New York City, leading to many misadventures in the big city. st: Baby; Marathon: Battle of the Sexes
d: Tattoo selects parents for an orphaned baby; a woman (Barbi Benton) competes in an all-male marathon to save her hometown.

st: Tony's Family; Man of the Cloth; Her Own Two Feet
d: The crew hides the family of a ship's engineer; a minister falls for an exotic dancer; an almost-blind woman won't admit her problem.
A teacher breathes life into Dorothy's decades-old crush on him; Rose makes her debut as a TV producer.

As a child, some of Henry's favorite memories are sitting together with his family and watching their favorite TV shows from the 70s and 80s; as an adult, he decided it would be cool to own costumes from some of the shows he loved best.
Hawkeye and B.J. become lost in enemy territory.
The company's young Korean table tennis champion persuades Hawkeye and B.J. to lend him money for an engagement ring.
Blanche fails to seduce her date and is heartbroken; Dorothy goes bananas over a "Beatlemania" cast member.
Dorothy dreams she is a contestant on "Jeopardy!" but the game is fixed in favor of neighbor Charlie Dietz.

st: Ebbtide VI: The Wrath of Stan
d: Dorothy and Stan are ordered by a judge to inhabit one of their substandard apartments.

st: Journey to the Center of Attention
d: Dorothy replaces Blanche as the center of attention for the men at Blanche's favorite nightspot.
Debra decides to make fish, turning upside down Thanksgiving traditions; the relatives watch something besides football.
Ray and his family are crushed when Marie cooks up a tofu turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
Archie and Mike lock horns over the soon-to-be-born baby Stivic's religion -- or lack of it.
Irene Lorenzo challenges Archie to a game of pool at Kelsey's Tavern.
Laura and Millie become stage mothers when their sons are cast in a TV commercial.
The Petries entertain a British duo (Chad & Jeremy).
An unexpected summons from the IRS throws Ralph into a panic.
Knowing the gangsters will track him down, Ralph hides at home after witnessing a bank robbery.
To find Hitler's hidden fortune, the IMF races a band of young Neo-Nazis intent on creating a new regime; guest Lee Bergère.
The mystery of the death of Richard Kimble's wife is fully unraveled in a final confrontation. Conclusion of the series.
Harry's probe of a friend's murder leads him to a county controlled by powerful trustees of a ranch; guest Joanna Pettet.
When Friday invites Gannon and his wife to dinner, the evening is interrupted by neighbors and a burglary.
Friday and Gannon meet a wide variety of clients when they work the robbery detail desk.
Malloy and Reed search for an elusive bar girl who can help to clear an officer of a blackmail charge.
An Italian agent goes along with a daring plan to photograph a Nazi installation.
Bill teaches Toony everything there is to know about action figures.
Wally gets his father's permission to buy a car but not the one he wants.
Wally and Eddie get jobs parking cars at a wedding reception.

st: The Case of the Garrulous Gambler
d: A man (Dick Foran) seeks Perry's help for his brother (Wynn Pierce), who has been forging checks to pay off gambling debts.
At a beach resort to attend a high-school sweetheart's funeral, Ben is drawn into the investigation of two men's deaths.
An artist's death spurs a series of puzzling homicides that seem linked to the dead man's estate; guest Helen Funai.
Mary Ellen falls for a minstrel and resists helping the family fulfill a vital contract.
A strict father, who thinks one of his own sons should hang for committing a murder, blames the wrong boy.
Little Joe is accused of bank robbery, and an unhappy wife claims he committed the crime for love of her.
Lucas and Marshal Torrance get into trouble with the Army when they try to help a wounded young soldier who deserted.
After Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother, he no longer seems interested in getting well.
A riverboat gambler who has committed murder pretends to be a parson traveling with his children. With Ward Bond and Robert Horton.
Gage is selected to be the model for an ideal firefighter; Brackett urges an aging doctor who has suffered a heart attack to retire.
A football hero creates a perplexing psychological problem for Hawkeye and B.J. when he suffers a wound that will end his career.
When B.J. attempts to comfort a nurse who has marriage troubles, he discovers a romantic problem of his own.
An outbreak of infectious hepatitis threatens the entire medical staff of the 4077th.
Hawkeye is picked to be the personal physician for a corps commander until he gives the general a physical.
Opie has a crush on his teacher, who is also Andy's girlfriend.
Andy and Aunt Bee help Barney reach the new civil service height and weight requirements so that he can keep his job.

Ray's press pass is refused when he and Robert visit the Baseball Hall of Fame; with former New York Mets Bud Harrelson, Ron Swoboda, Cleon Jones, Tug McGraw, Tommie Agee, Jerry Grote, Ed Kranepool and Art Shamsky.
Ray confesses to Debra that her cuddly sleeping position is preventing him from getting his rest.
After she sees Dorothy and Miles' spur-of-the-moment kiss, Sophia must tell this to Rose; the last thing she needs to do to break the curse is tell a friend of a betrayal.
After she sees Dorothy and Miles' spur-of-the-moment kiss, Sophia must tell this to Rose; the last thing she needs to do to break the curse is tell a friend of a betrayal.
Guests Ken Berry and Eydie Gorme appear in a lavish salute to RKO Pictures with movie spoofs aplenty; tax time is especially stressful for Harvey with "Carol & Sis" constantly disturbing him.

st: The Case of the Hasty Honeymooner
d: An eccentric millionaire is accused of poisoning his bride; guests Noah Beery, Strother Martin.
A down-on-his-luck trumpet player is given a second crack at life after being struck down by a truck.
